summary: Two byte-INVARIANT fixed-encoding low-nibble-6 ops decoded and validated: rtq_pred (06 c2 00 00, 4B, ray-query traversal predicate/condition word) and sfu_marker (06 02, 2B, SFU/transcendental helper marker -- the round-1 'family-only' 50-token gap, now NAMED). The remaining low-nibble-6 desyncs are ray-tracing-traversal cascade residue (a separate, still-unmodelled family) and are reported UNRESOLVED rather than fabricated. The screen-space derivative dfdx/dfdy/fwidth is NOT a low-nibble-6 op -- it is the pre-existing 0x37 tex_deriv (low-nibble 7); see notes.

lengthRules.note: Gated tight on b1==0xc2 so it never touches the pre-existing 2-byte 06 02 SFU marker. Anchored by clean resync of the following branch/iadd2 to program end across 44 own-compiled ray-query shaders and one isolated own kernel.

lengthRules.note: Was family-only (length known, no descriptor). No length-rule change required.

descriptors.semantics: Ray-query traversal predicate/condition word. Byte-INVARIANT 4-byte token (06 c2 00 00) the intersection_query compiler emits immediately after the candidate-status compare (icmp_pred, byte0 0x0a) and before its consumer (if_push conditional branch, or a predicated iadd2). Exclusively emitted inside intersection_query / ray-query traversal loops (0 occurrences in non-ray control-flow / int / float shaders). Exact micro-op is NOT-YET-CHARACTERIZED (candidate: predicate / execution-mask helper that gates the ray-query candidate/commit branch); documented as a fixed encoding + length only.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (OWN-MSL): invariant 06 c2 00 00 across 260 corpus occurrences in 44 own-compiled ray-query shaders, ALWAYS at a clean leader position directly after a 6-byte icmp_pred; independently reproduced in an isolated OWN ray-query kernel (corpus/dec2_n6_deriv/rq_pred.metal, 8 occurrences). Length 4 anchored by clean resync of the following branch/iadd2 to the program end. Compile-only M4 host: semantics inferred from position, NOT GPU-dispatch-validated.

descriptors.semantics: SFU / transcendental helper marker word. Byte-INVARIANT 2-byte token (06 02) the compiler emits adjacent to special-function-unit and varying/mesh output ops -- consistently after a 6-byte low-nibble-2 min/max range-reduction op and before an fspecial (2f/af) SFU op or an 0x80 output word. Appears in transcendental (sin/cos/pow), fragment/mesh output, and half-precision kernels. Fixed control token with no operand bits; exact micro-op NOT-YET-CHARACTERIZED. Per clean-room rule 5 the adjacent range-reduction coefficient words are deliberately left raw and are NOT bit-decoded here (naming a fixed opcode token reveals no algorithm).
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (OWN-MSL): invariant 06 02 across 59 corpus occurrences in 22 own-compiled shaders; reproduced in an isolated OWN fast::sin kernel (corpus/dec2_n6_deriv/sfu_marker.metal), where it sits between the range-reduction min/max op and the sin fspecial. Length 2 was already in the committed length rule (EXP-M4-12 S1); this descriptor only NAMES the previously family-only token. Compile-only M4 host: semantics inferred, NOT GPU-dispatch-validated.

notes: HIGH-NIBBLE TEST: rtq_pred and sfu_marker both have a byte0 whose high nibble is INVARIANT 0 across the entire corpus (never a dst register) -- confirmed by the byte-invariance survey. So for these two ops byte0 does NOT carry a dst; they are fixed control/marker tokens, not the usual (dst<<4)|op ALU shape.

DERIVATIVE (task-named 0x06/0x36): NEGATIVE / clarifying result. The screen-space derivative dfdx/dfdy/fwidth compiles to the pre-existing 0x37 tex_deriv op (low-nibble 7, already in the committed DB; axis at byte+6: 0x92=dfdx, 0x90=dfdy). fwidth = tex_deriv + fabs + fadd (lowered, not a dedicated op). There is NO distinct low-nibble-6 derivative encoding: deriv_scalar/vec4/half/fwidth fragment shaders tokenize with 0x37 tex_deriv and contain no genuine 0x06/0x36 leader. The only low-nibble-6 op adjacent to derivatives is sfu_marker (06 02), present in deriv_fwidth because it uses sin/cos.

The '0x86 desync ~212' from the round-1 triage is NOT a genuine 0x86 leader family: 0x86 is a middle-byte that the tokenizer lands on while cascading through the still-unmodelled ray-tracing traversal / commit path and the unmodelled 0x?b uniform_mov register-move chains. In the genuine-leader survey nearly every 0x86 desync has a prev token that is itself <unknown>/desync (e.g. 86 10 N=41, 86 12 N=29, 86 0a N=20 are all cascade). Assigning them lengths/fields from cascade-recovered boundaries would risk fabrication, so they are left UNRESOLVED.

SCOPE / clean-room stance: decoding the ray-tracing traversal 0x?6 residue (66 00 / 06 00 / 46 00 after falu3; 56 xx after rt_ray_mem; a6 b0; the 0x86 cascade bytes) requires FIRST modelling the ray-tracing traversal instruction family (rt_ray_mem exact length, the uniform_mov 0x?b chains, the ray-query commit ops) -- a different low-nibble ownership. Per the Prime Directive (better NO result than a TAINTED one) these are reported as unresolved with evidence, not guessed.
provenance: EXP-M4-13 R2, low-nibble-6 family. All facts from OWN-MSL: the pre-compiled EXP-M4-13 own-shader corpus (hex/) plus two isolated kernels I compiled here on the M4 host with shdump (corpus/dec2_n6_deriv/{rq_pred,sfu_marker}.metal). Method: compile -> agxparse --extract-hex -> table-driven tokenize -> byte-invariance survey + length bracketing. No Apple binary was disassembled or introspected. Compile-only host: NO GPU dispatch/splice -- semantics are inferred, encodings+lengths are byte-diff/anchor evidence.
